# Fastly
> Fastly’s edge cloud platform helps teams build, secure, and deliver fast websites, apps, APIs, and streaming experiences.

Fastly provides edge CDN, compute, security, observability, and media delivery products, with extensive documentation for platform setup, APIs, developer tooling, and operational guidance.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/): Central hub for Fastly product docs, guides, references, and tutorials.
- [Developer Hub](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/developers/): Entry point for developers building and operating services on Fastly.
- [Guides](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/): How-to documentation for configuration, delivery, security, and edge application workflows.
- [Reference](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/): Product, API, CLI, and configuration reference documentation.
- [Solutions](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/solutions/): Prescriptive implementation patterns for common delivery and security use cases.
- [Learning Center](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/learning/): Educational content for understanding Fastly concepts and platform capabilities.

## APIs and Platform Reference
- [API Reference Overview](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/api/): Overview of Fastly APIs for service management, security, and observability.
- [Fastly API Reference](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/api/): REST API documentation for configuring and automating Fastly services.
- [VCL Reference](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/vcl/): Reference for Fastly VCL variables, functions, statements, and behaviors.
- [Configuration Reference](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/configuration/): Detailed reference for service settings and platform configuration options.
- [CLI Reference](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/cli/): Command reference for the Fastly command-line interface.
- [Terraform Provider](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/terraform/): Infrastructure-as-code reference for managing Fastly with Terraform.

## Compute
- [Compute Overview](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/compute/): Guides for building and deploying applications on Fastly Compute.
- [Get Started with Compute](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/compute/getting-started/): Introductory setup and deployment guidance for Compute services.
- [JavaScript on Compute](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/compute/javascript/): Documentation for building Compute applications with JavaScript tooling.
- [Rust on Compute](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/compute/rust/): Documentation for building Compute applications using Rust.
- [Go on Compute](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/compute/go/): Guidance for developing and deploying Compute applications in Go.
- [Compute Concepts](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/compute/concepts/): Core concepts for execution model, services, backends, and edge behavior.

## CDN and Delivery
- [Delivery Guides](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/): Documentation for accelerating websites and applications with Fastly delivery services.
- [Getting Started with Fastly](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/): Initial setup guidance for creating services and sending traffic through Fastly.
- [Caching](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/caching/): Guides for cache behavior, freshness, invalidation, and optimization strategies.
- [Origins](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/origins/): Configuration guidance for connecting, securing, and tuning origin infrastructure.
- [TLS and Domains](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/domains-and-origins/): Documentation for domains, certificates, TLS, and traffic routing.
- [Image Optimization](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/image-optimization/): Guides for transforming and optimizing images at the edge.

## Security
- [Security Guides](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/security/): Documentation for securing applications, APIs, and edge services on Fastly.
- [Next-Gen WAF](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/next-gen-waf/): Guides for deploying and managing Fastly Next-Gen WAF protections.
- [DDoS Protection](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/ddos-protection/): Documentation for mitigating denial-of-service attacks and protecting availability.
- [Bot Management](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/bot-management/): Guidance for detecting and managing automated traffic and abuse.
- [TLS and Network Security](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/network-services/): Documentation for secure transport, edge networking, and related controls.
- [Access Control and ACLs](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/fastly-vcl/writing-vcl-code/): Guidance relevant to implementing request filtering and access policies in VCL.

## Observability and Logging
- [Observability Guides](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/integrations/streaming-logs/): Documentation for logs, metrics, and operational visibility integrations.
- [Streaming Logs](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/integrations/streaming-logs/): Configure real-time log streaming to external destinations and analytics systems.
- [Logging Endpoints](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/integrations/logging-endpoints/): Set up destination-specific logging integrations for supported providers.
- [Stats and Analytics](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/monitoring/): Monitor traffic, cache performance, and service behavior.
- [Alerts and Monitoring](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/integrations/): Integration guidance for monitoring and operational tooling.
- [Real-Time Data](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/api/): API access for service statistics and operational telemetry.

## Developer Tools and SDKs
- [Fastly CLI](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/cli/): Command-line tooling for service management, deployment, and debugging.
- [Code Examples](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/solutions/examples/): Example implementations for common edge delivery and compute scenarios.
- [Terraform](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/terraform/): Manage Fastly resources declaratively with the Terraform provider.
- [API Clients](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/api/): Use Fastly APIs from custom tooling and automation workflows.
- [Developer Guides](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/developers/): Resources for engineers integrating Fastly into applications and pipelines.
- [Fiddle](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/fastly-vcl/using-fastly-fiddle/): Test and share VCL snippets in Fastly’s browser-based playground.

## Media and Streaming
- [Media Delivery](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/media-delivery/): Documentation for optimizing video and large-object delivery at the edge.
- [Video on Demand](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/media-delivery/video-on-demand/): Guidance for delivering on-demand streaming content efficiently.
- [Live Streaming](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/media-delivery/live-streaming/): Best practices for low-latency live video delivery workflows.
- [Segmented Content Delivery](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/media-delivery/): Techniques for caching and delivering segmented media formats.
- [Image Optimization](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/image-optimization/): Edge image transformation and optimization for media-heavy experiences.

## Account and Service Management
- [Account Management](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/account-info/): Documentation for users, roles, billing, and account-level administration.
- [Service Configuration](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/services/): Create and manage Fastly services and versions.
- [Domains and DNS](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/domains/): Configure domains and route traffic through Fastly.
- [Backends](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/backends/): Define and manage origin backends for Fastly services.
- [Access Control](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/account-info/users/): Manage users, permissions, and organizational access.
- [Support and Status](https://www.fastly.com/documentation/guides/concepts/errors/): Troubleshooting guidance for common errors and operational issues.
